name: Beskonechnoe Leto 2
source:
Everlasting Summer 2 is an interactive visual novel about Alexey, a young man from the 21st century who falls asleep on a bus and wakes up in the Soviet-era summer camp “Sovyonok.” But the camp has changed: secrets are more plentiful, relationships more complicated, and few people Alexey meets behave the way he expects.

Alexey is swept into a whirlpool of new acquaintances, mysteries, and strange events. Not only must he find love, but also figure out what happened to the camp, why it has become different, and learn what it means for everyone involved.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《永恒的夏天2》是一部互动视觉小说，讲述了21世纪的年轻人阿列克谢在公共汽车上睡着后在苏联时代的夏令营“索维诺克”中醒来的故事。但营地已经发生了变化：秘密更加丰富，关系更加复杂，阿列克谢遇到的人很少按照他期望的方式行事。

阿列克谢陷入了新朋友、神秘事件和奇怪事件的漩涡中。他不仅必须找到爱，还要弄清楚营地发生了什么，为什么它变得不同，并了解这对每个参与其中的人意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247140/]Steam[/url]]
